title: Payment method
description: A brand a payer pays with (Alipay, iDEAL, Pix, Visa). One file per method: data/methods/<id>.yaml. Only methods usable for online checkout, bill pay or payment links.

id.description: Lowercase slug, unique in the registry, equal to the file name.

name.description: The name the brand goes by in English or internationally.

aliases.description: Other spellings, local-language names, and the names providers list this method under.

global.description: Payers are worldwide (Visa, PayPal). Used instead of `countries`.

countries.description: Where the brand's payers mainly are. ISO 3166-1 alpha-2. Left out when no source says.

currencies.description: Currencies the payer pays in. ISO 4217.
